literal_meaning: To make someone taste the fun or enjoyment
figurative_meaning_en: To put someone in trouble and subdue or overpower them
similar_in_english: give someone a taste of their own medicine
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে মজা চাখিয়ে জয়লাভ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He made his rival taste the fun and emerged victorious.
Wait, I'll show you some fun.
note: The idiom implies a sense of retaliation or making someone experience discomfort as a form of control, common in everyday Bengali banter.
